arc.fallback: Kakashi's Anbu Arc: The Shinobi That Lives in the Darkness

description.fallback: Despite his assignment to mentor a genin team, Kakashi consistently fails the teams he tests over their lack of team-work, wanting to make sure that no team will ever suffer the same losses his team had over what Kakashi perceived as improper team-work. Kakashi's interest is sparked when a team similar to his own, consisting of his sensei's orphan, Itachi's brother, and a clever kunoichi are to be evaluated by him....

intro.fallback: Despite his assignment to mentor a genin team, Kakashi consistently fails the teams he tests over their lack of team-work, wanting to make sure that no team will ever suffer the same losses his team had over what...
Kakashi's interest is sparked when a team similar to his own, consisting of his sensei's orphan, Itachi's brother, and a clever kunoichi are to be evaluated by him.
Despite his initial reservation and disappointment while meeting them, the team is able to grasp his lesson in team-work, ignoring the rules when one of their own needed help.

outro.fallback: Despite his initial reservation and disappointment while meeting them, the team is able to grasp his lesson in team-work, ignoring the rules when one of their own needed help.
Kakashi passes them and officially becomes their team leader.
